page_title: CLE 0-0 LIL | Clermont v Lille 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+1' The referee is firm and issues Yusuf Yazici (Lille) a deserved yellow card.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
86' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Johan Gastien and he is replaced by Yohan Magnin (Clermont).
86' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
85' Substitution. Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) replaces Benjamin Andre.
84' Goal disallowed! Remy Cabella (Lille) scores but Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
82' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) is given a yellow card.
81' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
79' Lucas Chevalier makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) after a cross from the side.
78' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Elbasan Rashani will be replaced by Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Grejohn Kyei as he is replaced by Shamar Nicholson (Clermont).
77' Habib Keita (Clermont) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
76' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
75' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

75' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. It will be a corner kick for Clermont.
70' Substitution. Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) on for Jim Allevinah.
70' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismaily (Lille) replacing Gabriel Gudmundsson.
70' A substitution has been made. Jonathan David goes off and Yusuf Yazici (Lille) comes on.
70' Remy Cabella (Lille) controls a great pass from Edon Zhegrova on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
69' Remy Cabella (Lille) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mory Diaw with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
68' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) picks up a yellow card.
67' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' Referee Florent Batta halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paulo Fonseca, then shows him a yellow.
65' Mory Diaw (Clermont) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
64' Mory Diaw (Clermont) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Remy Cabella (Lille) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
63' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
58' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
57' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the top left corner, but Mory Diaw is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
55' Johan Gastien (Clermont) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Lucas Chevalier keeps it out with an amazing save.
55' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
52' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
51' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Lucas Chevalier makes a magnificent save!
50' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the right post to safety.
49' A wild pass somehow finds Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
48' Benjamin Andre (Lille) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
46' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Jonathan David (Lille) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) sends a wild header high over the bar.
45' There's an opportunity for Johan Gastien (Clermont) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
45' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Clermont win a corner kick.
40' The foul by Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) was seen by Florent Batta who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' The ball is cleared after Edon Zhegrova (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
36' Johan Gastien (Clermont) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
35' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Clermont earn a corner.
34' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
33' Leny Yoro (Lille) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
33' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
29' Habib Keita (Clermont) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Lucas Chevalier makes a save.
25' Florent Batta blows his whistle and it's Muhammed Cham (Clermont) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Remy Cabella (Lille) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

20' What a wasted opportunity by Angel Gomes (Lille)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Mory Diaw makes an astonishing save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lille.
19' Remy Cabella (Lille) attempts to release Jonathan David with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
16' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
15' The Clermont players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) commits a foul and Florent Batta immediately signals a free kick.
8' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes it short.
8' Tiago Santos (Lille) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
8' The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Lille will kick the game off.
Florent Batta was nominated as the referee for this game.
